title: Will Stocks Rally After Election Day?
summary: Will stocks rally after the 2026 midterm elections, or is more volatility ahead? IBKR's Vrushabh Doshi sits down with Dave Keller, President and Chief Strategist at Market Misbehavior, to explore historical market patterns, shifting sector leadership, and what investors should watch as Wall Street heads into 2027.
